turns.learner: Hello! Can you give me an exercise on a, an and the?
turns.tutor:
Hello! Before you try, let me work through one example out loud.
My sentence: "She eats ___ apple." I say the next word: "apple". The first sound is "a", a vowel sound. So I choose an: She eats an apple.
Rule: use an before a vowel sound, and a before a consonant sound.
Right: He drives a car.
Wrong: He drives an car.

Now it is your turn. Write the missing word:
Write a or an: She has ___ orange in her bag. (answer with only the missing word)
